description: Certificate of lawfulness for an existing rear dormer with roof light on top, sun tunnels on rear roof slope with rooflights to front
decision_conditions: The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.

The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class C of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.
Flank Window in Gable Wall Informative

The applicant should note that the existing flank window within the gable wall requires planning consent due to a condition on the original consent preventing windows being added to the original building as such, this window cannot be done under permitted development.
